patches.name: widgets_unlocked_force_true
patches.reason: q6/h1.g case for c2.r (widgets_unlocked): drop the null branch and set the result register to 1, so Boolean.valueOf(v3) is always TRUE regardless of stored value.

patches.name: widgets_unlocked_del_nullcheck
patches.reason: the removed branch no longer guards this call; nop it so a (possibly null) Boolean is never dereferenced.

patches.name: widgets_unlocked_del_moveresult
patches.reason: its producing invoke was nop'd; a move-result must follow an invoke or the class fails to verify.

patches.name: premium_unlocked_force_true
patches.reason: q6/h1.g case for c2.p (premium_unlocked): drop the null branch and set the result register to 1.

patches.name: premium_unlocked_del_nullcheck
patches.reason: the removed branch no longer guards this call; nop it.

patches.name: premium_unlocked_del_moveresult
patches.reason: its producing invoke was nop'd; a move-result must follow an invoke.

patches.name: sigcheck_cached_path_true
patches.reason: s6/h3.a() case 10 gates premium (i0.C == 'signature matches hardcoded fingerprint'). Both paths converge on Boolean.valueOf(v0) at rel+0x250. Replace the cached-path move-result v0 with const/4 v0,1 so the cached result is ignored and TRUE is returned.

patches.name: sigcheck_compute_path_true
patches.reason: on the compute path, replace 'move v0, v1' with const/4 v0,1 so Boolean.valueOf(v0) returns TRUE without touching the (possibly failing) signature comparison.
